sources.label: Chegg Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
sources.note: Q2 product-line revenues; H1 operating cash flows and cash capex; cash/restricted-cash reconciliation; June balance sheet; Note 6 debt principal and carrying amount.
sources.limitation: June 30 balances precede the September debt repayment. Product-line revenues are disclosed; the contribution margins used in the model are not.

sources.label: Chegg Q2 2026 earnings release
sources.note: Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation; H1 free-cash-flow reconciliation; severance payments; capital-spending target; Q3 revenue and EBITDA guidance.
sources.limitation: Adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow are company-defined non-GAAP measures. Q3 guidance is management's August outlook, not a reported result or this article's forecast.

sources.label: Chegg announces full repayment of convertible notes
sources.note: Confirms repayment of remaining $33.9m principal and no outstanding debt. Approximately $38m cash and investments is explicitly June 30 pro forma for repayment.
sources.limitation: Does not disclose actual September 1 or September 30 cash. Debt-free status does not remove operating leases and other liabilities.

sources.label: Chegg FY2025 earnings release
sources.note: Full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA; management's two-business strategy: grow skilling and manage legacy academic services for cash.
sources.limitation: Strategic targets are management expectations, not proof of future growth or independent market sizing.

sources.label: Chegg Q1 2026 earnings release
sources.note: Q1 revenue, skilling growth and profitability; discussion of enterprise/channel partnerships and AI-focused offerings.
sources.limitation: Quarterly growth and named distribution partnerships do not establish long-run retention, unit margins or customer acquisition payback.

sources.label: Chegg receives a new NYSE continued-listing notice
sources.note: New minimum-price notice, separate from the earlier cured notice; six-month cure period and stated reverse-split option.
sources.limitation: The July disclosure does not establish that later compliance was restored. No delisting or implemented split is inferred.

sources.label: Chegg Q1 2026 prepared remarks and graduate survey
sources.note: Self-reported graduate outcomes: 43% greater efficiency and 41% improved work quality; source of the commercial-usefulness discussion.
sources.limitation: Graduate self-reports are selected observations, not a controlled causal estimate for all learners or proof of employer renewal.

sources.label: Chegg annual-meeting results and earlier NYSE compliance
sources.note: Shareholders approved reverse-split flexibility; board chose not to implement then after receiving June1 compliance confirmation.
sources.limitation: Superseded on minimum-price status by the July24 new notice; approval is not implementation.
